q01:
The program is ahead of pace to date, but if nothing changes it lands at 57329 doors on Election Day, 3303 short of the 60632 goal.
- All offices: 33503 doors to date vs a goal to date of 32431 (103.3%); projected 57329, which is 94.6% of goal, a shortfall of 3303 [table:v_office_pace]
- Northside: 112.5% of goal to date; projected 23583 vs a 22675 goal, 908 over [table:v_office_pace]
- Harbor: 105.3% of goal to date; projected 19150 vs a 20157 goal, 1007 short [table:v_office_pace]
- Eastgate: 89.3% of goal to date; projected 14596 vs a 17800 goal, 3204 short (82% of goal) [table:v_office_pace]
- Method: the projection is doors to date plus the last 7 days' average daily doors times the 16 knocking days left; the shortfall is goal minus projection [doc:program-plan#pace-and-projection]
q03:
To hit goal, Eastgate needs 4.4 more shifts a day, Harbor 1.3 more, and Northside none, which is 4.1 extra shifts a day program-wide.
- Eastgate: 12.6 shifts a day needed vs 8.3 a day over the last 7 days, so 4.4 extra [table:v_office_pace]
- Harbor: 11.1 needed vs 9.9, so 1.3 extra [table:v_office_pace]
- Northside: 10.1 needed vs 11.1, so 0 extra [table:v_office_pace]
- All offices: 33.3 needed vs 29.3, so 4.1 extra [table:v_office_pace]
- Method: doors still needed divided by knocking days left, divided by the last 7 days' doors per shift; extra shifts is that minus the last 7 days' average shifts per day [doc:program-plan#shifts-needed]
q05:
Ask the client for more doors: at our current pace we can knock 23826 more doors, but only 10393 untouched doors are left in our turf, so we will run out of first-pass turf.
- Capacity for the rest of the program: 23826 doors (1489.1 a day over the last 7 days x 16 days left) [table:v_office_pace]
- Untouched doors left: 10393 program-wide; Eastgate 1183, Harbor 8096, Northside 1114 [table:v_turf_summary]
- Office capacity vs untouched: Eastgate 6091 vs 1183, Northside 9936 vs 1114, Harbor 7798 vs 8096 (Harbor alone still has enough turf) [table:v_office_pace]
- Doors still needed to reach goal: 27129 program-wide [table:v_office_pace]
- A second pass on the 18555 not-home doors is the fallback [table:v_turf_summary]
- Rule: when capacity is larger than untouched doors, ask for more doors first, since new turf contacts voters at the normal first-pass rate and second passes at roughly half of it [doc:program-plan#more-doors-or-a-second-pass]
q07:
The client's report counts attempts before QC rollbacks, while our dashboard counts doors once per day with rollbacks removed; on Oct 12 that gap was 203, mostly 142 rolled-back attempts in Eastgate.
- All offices: 1484 attempts (client report) vs 1281 doors on our dashboard, a gap of 203: 142 rolled-back attempts plus 61 repeat attempts [table:v_daily_doors]
- Eastgate: client shows 498 vs our 342, a gap of 156: 142 rolled back plus 14 repeat attempts [table:client_daily_report] [table:v_daily_doors]
- Harbor: client shows 428 vs our 406, a gap of 22, all repeat attempts [table:client_daily_report] [table:v_daily_doors]
- Northside: client shows 558 vs our 533, a gap of 25, all repeat attempts [table:client_daily_report] [table:v_daily_doors]
- Why: the gap is repeat attempts at the same door plus attempts later rolled back; a larger gap almost always means a rollback [doc:counting-doors#why-the-client-s-numbers-differ-from-ours]

q13:

- All offices: 8.1, 6.1, 4.3, then 3.4 flags per 100 shifts over the four weeks from Sep 21 [table:v_qc_weekly]
- Harbor: 6.2 last week to 1.4 this week [table:v_qc_weekly]
- Northside: 3 last week to 1.3 this week [table:v_qc_weekly]

x04:
Flash knocking is recording doors faster than a person can walk to them and knock; a shift is flagged when 10 or more consecutive knocks are recorded less than 30 seconds apart.
- Threshold: 10 or more consecutive knocks, each less than 30 seconds apart [doc:qc-rules#flash-knocking]
- Confirmed flash knocking is rolled back: those knocks no longer count as doors or contacts, and a whole shift recorded that way is rolled back in full [doc:qc-rules#flash-knocking]
- Rollbacks happen after the day's client report is pulled, so they don't change a report already sent [doc:counting-doors#rollbacks]
- Every open flag needs a field lead conversation before the canvasser's next shift; two or more in one week go to the field director [doc:qc-rules#what-happens-after-a-flag]
